roles.summary: Build a secured, tested LLM-backed API with streaming responses and clear error handling.

roles.project:
💻 Backend Software Engineer

🎯 Build: Ship a permissioned LLM endpoint with structured responses, streaming, retries, and automated tests.

📦 Deliver: A documented HTTP service, validated schemas, a streaming endpoint, test fixtures, and an example permission policy.

✅ Role-specific pass test: Tests cover schema validation, streaming disconnects, retries and unauthorized requests.

🧰 Suggested local stack: Python / FastAPI or your existing backend stack; a mock LLM is enough to start.

🛠️ Open the 4-step build plan and acceptance checks

Build in four stages

  1. Define a request/response schema and local mock model; write a health check and one valid response test.

Pass only when…

  • 401/403 for invalid/unauthorized requests
  • Schema-invalid model output fails validation
  • Disconnect or timeout does not leave work running indefinitely
